issues.description: Section A constructs the original month from announcement-date text at line 57; month_b is an abbreviation used only in the date string at line 88. Line 78 drops the original month before line 90 renames it, and line 114 renames it back before the currency merge at line 121. Preserve the original variable through this sequence; its external key type/encoding is not documented.
Line 124 combines rate multiplication and destring text on one Stata source line. The actual conversion-factor field and direction are unknown, so the intended replacement cannot be guessed.

Many direct source files and manual/prepared joins are absent. Requirements record each consumed filename and its actual keys/fields; authors must supply matching files or exact producers and field/history dictionaries.

The script writes target_list_tomerge.dta but consumes distinct 50% and 30% target-list aliases; no producer is shown for these aliases, type_50_50/type_30_30/type_private, or the branch-specific toehold files. Preserve each branch until same-key and population compatibility is documented.

Daily target/acquirer event inputs need exact event-date matches, t−253…t−127 estimation observations and returns through t+126. Prepared files, event population and lower date bound are not supplied; catalog probes read one row only.

The SDC base is worldwide but treatment country, lower history bound, market/exchange population and SDC-to-ISIN handoffs are unspecified. Datastream price/index definitions and Amadeus/BvD and FactSet/LionShares country aggregates remain separate, unverified source contracts; local probes/catalog metadata do not prove entitlement or coverage.

BDO.do hardcodes a Windows G: root and backslash subdirectories. A host-visible relative execution root and consistent paths across all read/write calls are needed; preserve exchange_rate, interest rate and acq new returns subdirectories.

review_notes: Full BDO.do, datasheet and online appendix were read. The CUSIP workbook is identifiers in separate final-stake sheets; its bounded probe does not establish full-data coverage.

The 19 frozen dependency edges are all dispositioned; the draft also enumerates direct source/prepared inputs and producer handoffs beyond those edges, with linked actions.
